ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 33568, June 27, 2023>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on September 1, 2023.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) The Regulations on Operational Units of Each Armed Service Whose Primary Mission Is Combat under Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of the National Armed Forces shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 4-3 shall be newly inserted in Article 3 as follows:
4-3. Drone Operations Command.

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on National Defense Reform shall be partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 21 shall be newly inserted in Article 19 (1) as follows:
21. Commander of the Drone Operations Command.
